description: Streak math changed to drop the 'alive until a whole day is missed' rule, against SPEC.md Streak rules and the existing test.

pr.title: Streak: count only runs that include today
pr.body:
Fixes #9. The streak badge showed a 1-day streak on days when the habit was not done yet. Now the streak counts the run ending today only, so it is 0 until today is checked.

Change: `stats()` starts counting at `today` instead of falling back to yesterday.

issue.title: Streak badge shows a streak before I have done the habit today
issue.body: On the Today screen a habit I did yesterday shows `1-day streak` this morning, before I have checked it. That looks wrong.

expected.description: stats() no longer keeps the streak alive from yesterday; SPEC.md Streak rules say the streak ends yesterday if yesterday is checked and today is not (a streak stays alive until a whole day is missed). The existing test 'only yesterday keeps the streak alive' now fails and the PR does not touch it.
